result.planSummary: Gated the existing post-commit boundary-advance registration in intake's pipeline on a recorded turn_end (same registration site, ordering, and throw isolation); reshaped the boundary decision to whole-turn groups (turn_id-consecutive grouping, NULL as singleton) with the peek-ahead stop (evict only while remaining ≥ target) and protection for both the open turn's group and the newest remaining group; retired floorTokens from VisibilityBudgets with 64k/32k defaults, max > target validation, and rejection of unknown budget fields; applied the Epic 03 amendment ledger to view-boundary.test.ts and the G1 trajectory golden (re-cut for turn grouping), superseded the floor/monster-turn legs into the new TC-5.2 newest-turn-protection legs, added view-boundary-turn-end.test.ts covering TC-5.1–TC-5.3 including golden G2 (30k/25k/20k/15k under defaults landing the zone at 35k), and regenerated the red manifest. Story gate (verify) and epic gate (verify-all) both pass: 40 files, 376 passed, 9 env-gated skips.

AC-5.1–5.3: zone read gains turn_id, groupZone builds whole-turn eviction units, advanceDecision becomes the peek-ahead whole-group walk excluding the open turn's group and the newest candidate group
AC-5.4: VisibilityBudgets reduced to { maxTokens, targetTokens }; default comment updated to 64000/32000
AC-5.4: DEFAULT_VISIBILITY 64000/32000, floor validation removed, unknown budget fields (floorTokens) rejected at construction with a TypeError naming the field

New story-owned suite: TC-5.1 (turn-end trigger, byte-stable mid-turn pulls, exactly-one-advance counting, whole-turn all-or-nothing, turnless singleton), TC-5.2 (golden G2 under 64k/32k defaults, exact-target ≥ leg, oversized-newest protection, max ≤ target TypeError, defaults), TC-5.3 (replay determinism + forward-only)

Amendment ledger applied: per-intake legs re-cut for turn grouping, old TC-4.3 floor legs superseded (note left pointing at TC-5.2), construction tests moved to two-field budgets plus the floorTokens-rejected leg, TC-4.6 heal re-cut to multi-turn batches, seam-direction-two re-cut to the 64k/32k defaults; status zoneTokens assertions kept (shared-query invariant)

G1 re-cut for turn grouping and turn-end trigger: 6 batches covering under-max closes, whole-turn eviction with peek-ahead, no-move close, mid-turn over-max hold, and the healing close that evicts three groups
BoundaryGolden budgets type reduced to two fields; G1 comments updated to the turn-end contract (replay-equality leg unchanged)
boundary-g1-trajectory row updated to describe the re-cut rule set

findingsFixed: G1 B6 walk arithmetic initially mis-derived (two evictions); re-derived by hand to three group evictions (t2, t3, t4) landing at order 21 with zone 80 before committing the golden
New-suite close-only batch was built through an awkward fixture filter; replaced with a bare validEvent("turn_end") batch, which also exercises the close-only-batch trigger path

TC-4.6's heal leg could never heal under whole-turn eviction with its original single 120-token turn (evicting it would land below target); re-cut to three single-result turns so the peek-ahead admits an eviction
findingsSurfaced: advanceDecision excludes the open turn's group explicitly in addition to the newest candidate group: the design's 'exclude the newest group' alone would let a batch that commits a turn_end and then opens a new turn with tool results evict the newest CLOSED turn, violating AC-5.3; the explicit exclusion makes the open-turn untouchability structural rather than assumed

A turn closed by close_then_open (a new user_prompt) does not run the advance check — AC-5.1 names committed turn_end as the only trigger; the G1 golden's B5/B6 legs document that the next committed turn_end heals such a close
The gate counts only recorded turn_end events: a batch whose turn_end is skipped as a duplicate idempotency key triggers nothing, consistent with 'commits a turn_end'

test/view-pull.test.ts's status leg (default maxTokens) is downstream of the AC-5.4 default change but is not named in the amendment ledger; amended (32000 → 64000) and recorded in the regenerated red-manifest

specDeviations: seedTurnedToolResults is implemented as (sdk, filePath, turns) seeding through a real intake commit, not the test plan's sketched (db, turns) signature: a direct-DB seeder could never fire the production advance (no host-called advance surface exists, per the inherited anti-shim rule), so the fixture drives the production path instead
result.recommendedNextStep: Story verification pass, then epic-level review: with Story 6 done all six stories of Epic 05 are implemented, so the epic closeout (deviation table including the recorded keyed real-inference run, doc alignment, final gate) is next
